events.speaker: MODESTY
events.text: Sit still. The plate takes what it takes, whether the sitter's comfortable with it or not. Mind my case while you're at it -- it's the only one I've got.

events.speaker: MODESTY
events.text: Developed clean, case intact, and the plate held exactly what I pointed it at. No more, no less. I find that disappoints most people.

events.speaker: MODESTY
events.text: A place where I can point a camera at things without being told to put it away. I accept.

events.speaker: MODESTY
events.text: I've got a plate of you now. It came out steadier than I expected, and so, it turns out, did you.
